chunks: Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: “Regarding one who kills a hunting dog, he said: its value is to be assessed; and likewise the hunting hawk, and likewise the sheep dog, and likewise the orchard/watch dog.”

key_terms.كَلْبُ الْحَائِطِ: a guard dog for a walled garden, enclosure, or orchard
key_terms.كَلْبُ الْغَنَمِ: a sheep dog used to protect livestock
key_terms.يُقَوِّمُهُ: its monetary value is assessed for compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone kills a hunting dog or other useful trained animals in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning liability for killing certain beneficial animals. It states that compensation is due based on assessed value for a hunting dog, a hawk, a sheep dog, and a guard dog for an enclosure or orchard.
